Uses of Enum Class
io.webagent4j.locator.api.ElementRole

Packages that use ElementRole
Package
Description
io.webagent4j.dom
The backend-neutral live-element vocabulary shared by the locator, action, extraction, and observation subsystems - depends only on immutable, backend-neutral contracts.
io.webagent4j.locator
 
io.webagent4j.locator.api
Immutable, backend-neutral locator definitions and the fluent query contracts every semantic search builds on - IFind and ILocator contain no engine logic and no backend-native type.
io.webagent4j.observation
The immutable semantic observation model, options, renderers, diff, fingerprint, and the batch-capture backend SPI (io.webagent4j.observation.spi) - depends on webagent4j-dom and webagent4j-locator-api only, never on a browser backend.
io.webagent4j.observation.spi
